title: Onboarding failure, exception and recovery controls
workflow: Capture typed failure with redacted context and immutable correlation ID
Determine transient technical issue versus document or legal disqualification
Suspend only affected step and retain case in safe pending/review state
Retry eligible technical operations with idempotency and bounded backoff
Escalate unknown results, contradictory evidence or suspected fraud to qualified owner
Resume after verified resolution using the original case and source provenance
requirements: Provider timeout never implies identity was verified
Do not automatically delete incomplete cases because a device disconnected
Retries must not create duplicate CIF/customer numbers
Regulated investigation and suspicious-case details must remain access restricted
Unknown source result cannot be normalized into negative or positive certainty
Error screens and API responses reveal no private information about another customer's candidate matches
test_cases: Simulated registry downtime leaves case pending rather than approved
Duplicated upload callback does not duplicate evidence record
Retry after crash resumes with same case ID
Unauthorized support agent cannot force-approve exception
Failed screening query retains unresolved review obligation
closure_gate: Institution case-handling SOP, exception reason taxonomy, secure operator roles and executed outage/replay tests.
